title: Dan B NDE 4245
content: I was sitting around talking with friends when I felt my heart speed up faster and faster and then stop. I felt myself being pulled away from the scene, but then other scenes appeared and pulled away in smaller and smaller concentric squares. This was very frightening to me. I began reliving my life. Whilst I was seeing it from my perspective, I was also experiencing my every action as everyone affected by my actions. I could literally feel the concentric circles of 'emotion' going out from me, as they were experienced by each person in turn: I affect John, John affects Ray, Ray affects Sam, etc., and I experienced all of it. I was still frightened and sad about my life. After the life review I was shown (I don't remember a guide) how every person, every thought, every action and every word are connected. It looked like a vast web of stars that existed in many dimensions. I had been asking 'what is the point?' the whole time, but suddenly I was in the presence of a great ball of light, which was in the palm of a great hand. At that time, I experienced bliss, until I was pulled away and I found myself with my friends again. They were discussing which hospital to take me to.
